data.one_liner: Windows implementation of the path_provider plugin
data.what_it_does: Provides a Windows platform implementation for retrieving commonly used locations on the filesystem, such as temporary and documents directories. It is an endorsed federated plugin that works transparently through the main path_provider package.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter application for Windows and need access to standard filesystem directories
You are using the path_provider package in a multiplatform app that targets Windows
avoid_when: Your application does not target the Windows platform
You need custom file picking or saving dialogs instead of standard application directories
strengths: Automatically included when using the main path_provider package due to endorsement
Uses direct FFI usage for Windows integration
weaknesses: Limited specifically to the Windows platform implementation
data.setup_notes: This package is endorsed, meaning it will be automatically included when using path_provider normally. You only need to add it to pubspec.yaml if you import it directly.

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main federated package that automatically delegates to this platform-specific implementation.
